title: EWA desktop orchestration turn — optional metadata.companion (v1)
description: Wire shape for client hints under ewa_desktop_orchestration_v1 payload.metadata. Malformed values are dropped server-side; unknown top-level metadata keys and unknown companion keys are tolerated (companion extras ignored with debug logging). Canonical seed ids match api/schemas/ewa_companion.validate_seed.

AmbientAdjustCompanionHintV1.description: Optional telegraph aligning with companion action kind ambient_adjust normalization (services/ewa_companion/actions.py). Does not execute by itself — expansion stays in companion chat / ambient_actions pipeline.

mood.description: Mood preset key routed through mood_palette (e.g. warm, focus, dusk).

theme_ref.description: Optional catalog theme discriminator when operator enables strict wiring.

rationale.description: Short audit string for journaling / Companion UI — never authoritative policy.

CatalogSeedPersonaId.description: Catalog seed persona id (case-insensitive on the server after strip).

DesktopOrchestrationCompanionHintsV1.description: Optional companion hints mirrored in turn persistence.client and SSE companion_context (normalized). At most one seed field is emitted: seed_persona_id is read first; client_seed_persona_id is used when seed_persona_id is absent.

ambient_adjust.description: Optional SPA hint that companion mood/ambient tooling may reinterpret when EWA_COMPANION_AMBIENT_ACTIONS_ENABLED and chat affordances permit.

seed_persona_id.description: Preferred key for catalog seed hint.

client_seed_persona_id.description: Alias for seed_persona_id when the preferred key is omitted.

expect_companion_revision.description: Optimistic concurrency: compare to loaded companion_revision when profile is loaded. Non-integer wire values may be coerced from decimal integer strings via server normalization; booleans and non-positive values are skipped with diagnostics (hints_warnings / server warnings).

DesktopOrchestrationTurnMetadataExtensio.description: Optional metadata bag on POST /api/v1/ewa/desktop-orchestration/turn payloads (ewa_desktop_orchestration_v1). Beyond companion, additional keys are accepted and ignored by companion normalization.
